purpose: RAW (un-normalized) htmlToText output for the same eleven ids as fixtures-mcp-report-sections-bedcc23.json. U-16 asserts BOTH: normalized text against the capture, and raw text against this sidecar. Needed because the capture stores whitespace-normalized text (\s+ -> " ") and therefore cannot see a newline-only change.
provenance: NOT a re-capture. RE-DERIVED at UX-B implementation time by running the same htmlToText helper over the bedcc23 revision of site/index.html, whose sha256 was verified against the capture's own indexHtmlSha256 before these hashes were written. The capture file itself is byte-unchanged: extending it in place would blur captured evidence with later-derived evidence (UX-B design gate P1-7).
